# Introduction

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Introduction

As we know, a binary tree contains two essential pieces of information:

1. Data contained by the nodes.
2. Relationship between the nodes.

Consider the following tree.

![A Binary Tree](data:image/png;base64,)

Drawing a tree is time-consuming and space-inefficient. So, we will represent the tree as an array.

In an array,

- The data stored in the array represents the data contained in the nodes.
- The position (index) of the data represents the relationship between the nodes.

##### How does it work?
